purpose: 선택 근거가 대리 판단이나 강요된 합의가 아니라 정해진 두 수호령이 사실·현실 조건·불확실성을 독립 제어점으로 나누는 shared-world 12개 편집 검토안이다. 2026-09-05 사용자 승인에 따라 한국어 해석·질문·제목·그림 설명의 교정본을 반영했다. 원화와 최초 제작·시각 승인 이력은 유지한다.

renderContract.commonPrompt: Use case: illustration-story. Asset type: premium choice-evidence shared-world guardian card master artwork, full-bleed 3:4. Show exactly the two named guardians or canonical internal pair and no third guardian, adviser, user figure, audience, future self, human, silhouette, reflection or implied person. Preserve both canonical identities, relative size and colors, clothing, signature props, dark-purple eyes and visible chest Stella stars. The pair plus one shared evidence setting covers 55–65% and reads at 80px. Give each guardian one independent fact, condition, safety or uncertainty control and keep a broad open listening gap; never imply hierarchy, proxy decision, compulsory disclosure, correct choice, certainty, verdict, destiny or guaranteed outcome. Written surfaces use isolated symbols and geometric reliefs only: no readable text, pseudo-text, names, labels, score, number, date, clock face, calendar grid, map coordinate, question mark, zodiac glyph, arrow route, logo or watermark. Do not bake actual birth-chart lines or personal colors into the master art. Boards, trays, doors, seals, models, bottles and bays remain open, removable, blank or shared without forced convergence. Libra may use exactly one abstract evidence balance; no other sign uses a scale. Only Scorpio canonical tail-heart is allowed; no added heart. No closed ring, halo, portal, infinity sign or deterministic route. Keep every composition distinct. Soft colored-pencil and watercolor, paper grain, plush proportions and deep-purple outlines; no readable text, no logo, no watermark.
